skills.delivery_notes: 6-meter lunge clawing all foes in path — dash_attack geometry. Physical melee. No element: 'icy fangs' on Wolf Shade = flavor STRIKE per hot-fact, not damage-type descriptor. Element-silent.

Shadow copy placed at Berserker position. 'Wolf Shade appears at same position as Berserker' and 'leeches 33% of damage dealt back to the Berserker' — placed light-proxy (totem). Leech = self-heal mechanism, not an enemy ailment. No ailment attested.
Frenzy state: Charge bar full triggers 6s of 100% crit chance + movement speed. Self_buff via Charge threshold activation.

mapping_json.motion_frame: Deliver Wolf Strike lunges and auto-attacks building Charge on-hit; full Charge bar triggers 6s Frenzy (100% crit + move speed); Wolf Shade as light proxy at high Charge.

resource_economy.charge_note: Charge fills from melee hits; full bar triggers Frenzy state (6s duration); refills rapidly from combat — Frenzy Mastery extension considered weak late-game

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: 'Icy fangs' on Wolf Shade = flavor descriptor per hot-fact — STRUCK. No cold damage-type attested anywhere. Wolf Shade is placed-proxy (totem), not a following companion. Leech on Wolf Shade is self-healing not ailment. TEMPORAL_CHARGE fits Charge-into-Frenzy cycle. MOMENTUM_CASCADE fits 100% crit + movement speed cascade during Frenzy. charge_stack_sub_shape=cycle (fills, empties on Frenzy trigger, refills rapidly).
